An Indian software business seeking Japanese customers

Technical capability alone may not make an offer easy to buy.

The situation

An Indian software company wants Japanese customers. It needs to establish which buyers could benefit, what evidence they require, and how contracting, integration and support would work.

How SetuHashi could help

Assess market fit, develop Japan-ready positioning and documentation, identify suitable local partners and support discussions with prospective customers.

What the assignment could produce

An entry assessment, adapted offer, proposed partner route and a tracked customer-development programme.

The intended value

An offer Japanese buyers can evaluate, with a practical route for purchasing and support.

Related services

  • Reach customers in Japan
  • Adapt your offer for the market
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
